description: Experiment registry. Every run records fixture, seed, model, and result. Results stay 'pending' until the test actually runs; nothing is manufactured.

experiments.question: Does the graph validate and replay deterministically (byte-for-byte)?
Does a compound shock produce plausible monotone behavior and quantified uncertainty?
Does the containment optimizer respect constraints and beat no-action on the compound case?
Is model disagreement interpretable (localized with reasons and next steps)?
Do hidden dependencies increase reported uncertainty instead of silently disappearing?
Do humans find bottlenecks faster / decide better with the war room than with a static dependency list?
experiments.seed_policy: fixed seed per session, blinded conditions
experiments.evidence: Requires human tabletop exercise; protocol in research/experiments/EXP-N006-human-tabletop.md
